'''Alanna''' (Japanese: '''アキナ''' ''Akina'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG039|A Poké-BLOCK Party]]''.

Alanna met {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} outside of the [[Trick House]]. Like them, she wanted to enter the Trick House contest in order to win the one-year supply of [[Pokéblock]]s. She was accompanied by her {{p|Whismur}}. Alanna seemed to be a fan of [[Trick Master|The King of Tricks]], admitting that he was eccentric and fun, while {{an|May}} thought he was crazy.

During the maze portion of the Trick House, Alanna became separated from her Whismur. {{TRT}} wasted no time and used this opportunity to steal Whismur, hoping to give it to {{an|Giovanni|their boss}}. However, when the trio eventually foudn their way out the maze, Alanna saw that they had her Whismur, but because Team Rocket were wearing [[List of Team Rocket's disguises|disguises]], she thought that they had rescued it.

Alanna stuck with Ash and his friends through the rest of the Trick House. However, they kept getting sabotaged by Team Rocket. The trio eventually attempted to steal Whismur and [[Ash's Pikachu]] again. This time, Ash and Alanna battled them and sent Team Rocket blasting off. Unfortunately, none of them reached the end of the Trick House first, as a boy named [[Ivan]] was the winner.

Alanna brought Whismur with her to the [[Trick House]] contest, hoping to improve the pair's friendship and battling skills. {{TRT}} managed to kidnap Whismur on two occasions, but it was quickly recovered. Whismur used an ear-splitting combination of noise [[move]]s to defeat [[Jessie's Seviper]] in the second confrontation.

Alanna's Whismur developed a friendship with the recurring {{an|Jigglypuff}} as, due to its {{a|Soundproof|Ability}}, it was the only one who did not fall asleep during its {{m|Sing}}ing.  Whismur was later left exhausted from battling and went to sleep. Jigglypuff, however, believed that it fell asleep because of its song and scribbled on its face in anger before storming off.

Whismur's known moves are {{m|Screech}}, {{m|Supersonic}}, and {{m|Hyper Voice}}, and its Ability is {{a|Soundproof}}.}}
